title: Missing box office
statementMd:
List movies with no recorded `gross_millions`.

Expected columns: `title`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title FROM movies WHERE gross_millions IS NULL;
```
